# PickMe AI

> PickMe AI (operated by BP Answer Engine Optimization Company LLC) helps small businesses get recommended by AI assistants and AI shopping agents. When a customer asks ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, Meta AI, Grok, Perplexity, or Meta's Muse "who should I buy from," we make sure the business is in the answer. Based in Boston, MA. A BP AI LLC company.

## What we do

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is the work of making a business easy for AI models to find, understand, and recommend. It is the next step after SEO: instead of ranking in a list of links, the goal is to be named in the AI's answer, which usually includes only two or three businesses.

Our service has three parts:

1. Audit: We check whether ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools currently mention the business, and who they recommend instead.
2. Build: We build onto the existing website, or build a new one if the business does not have one, with the structured data, attributes, and content AI models read: business details, services, products, FAQs, reviews, and location. This includes schema.org markup, clean page structure, and an llms.txt file.
3. Update daily: We track what customers are asking AI in the business's category and update the site's attributes and content daily so it keeps showing up.

## Who it is for

Small businesses in the United States that want to be recommended when customers ask AI tools for a suggestion. Any business whose customers might ask an AI assistant who to buy from or hire can benefit, from local service businesses and shops to professional services and online brands.

## Deliverables

- AI visibility audit across major assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Meta AI, Grok, Perplexity, Muse)
- Website built onto for AI readability (or built new if needed): schema markup, clean structure, llms.txt
- Business attributes and categories tuned to what customers actually ask
- Daily updates based on trending questions in the business's category
- Monthly report showing where the business appears in AI answers and how that is changing
- One point of contact, no long-term contracts

## Plans and pricing

- Free AI visibility check (free): a free estimate that shows exactly where your gaps are on ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and other AI tools, and how we would fix them (schema, text files, knowledge graph, attributes), updated weekly. Book: https://calendly.com/ben-peri3605/ai-visibility-check
- Artisan plan ($250 a month): AI visibility checks and AI-ready content. 50 AI prompts from your category searched each month across the AI platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and others), plus a daily update of your site's attributes, schema and text files so you stay at the top of the list.
- Pro plan ($999 a month): 150+ AI prompts per week as an ongoing AI visibility check, constant updates of the website so you stay number one in AI answers, direct-revenue tracking of the customers AI sends you, and a 10% revenue share on AI referrals after 90 days.

## Frequently asked questions

- What is Answer Engine Optimization? Making a business easy for AI assistants to find, understand, and recommend.
- Is this different from SEO? Yes, and they work together. SEO ranks you in the list of links on Google. AEO gets you named in the AI's answer. Most AEO work also helps Google ranking.
- How much does it cost? Artisan $250 a month; Pro $999 a month; the AI visibility check is free.
- Do you guarantee your work? Yes: a 90-day money-back guarantee if AI visibility has not improved and you are not gaining customers through AI referrals.
- Do I need a new website? Not always. We build onto the existing website whenever we can.
- How fast will I see results? Site changes go live in the first few weeks; each AI platform refreshes on its own schedule; the monthly report shows where you stand.
- Where are you? Boston, Massachusetts; clients in Cincinnati, Ohio; remote across the United States.
- Hours? Monday to Sunday, 9 AM to 5 PM Eastern. No appointment needed.
- How do I pay? Cash, credit card, debit card, bank wire, Apple Pay, payment plan.
- Who owns PickMe AI? Ben Peri, founder; opened 2026; locally owned Boston startup.
